profile.ja: 紅血卿。カーラ・クロムウェル。魔界を支配する９つの有力貴族の一角で、魔界北部中央に広大な領地を有する吸血鬼。ノマドを率いるエドウィン・ブラックの姉。側近に金竜騎士団を率いる魔界騎士マリカ・クリシュナがいる。バカンスにビーチを訪れれば、彼女は陽射しなどものともせずに水着姿を披露する。
profile.en: The Crimson Blood Knight, Cara Cromwell, is one of the nine powerful nobles who dominate the Demon Realm, possessing a vast domain in the northern central Demon Realm as a vampire. They are the older sibling of Edwin Black, who leads the Nomads. Their close aide is the demon knight Marika Krishna, leader of the Golden Dragon Knights. When they visit a beach on vacation, they flaunt a swimsuit without a care for the sunlight.

text.ja: ああら、こんな所で会うなんて、奇遇ねぇ。どうしたの、そんなに意外？　私だって羽を伸ばしにリゾートへ来ることだってあるわ
text.en: Well, what a coincidence to run into each other here. What's up, so surprised? Even I sometimes come to a resort to stretch my wings.

text.ja: 今日はやけにフランク？　当たり前でしょう。今ここにいるのは紅血卿カーラではなく、ただリゾートを楽しみに来た魔族カーラだからよ
text.en: You're being unusually frank today? Of course. The one here isn't the Crimson Blood Knight Kara, but just the demon Kara who came to enjoy the resort.

text.ja: ここにはカリヤも来ているのよ。スネークレディと言った方が分かりやすいかしら？　どこかその辺りに……あら、呼ばなくていいって？
text.en: Kariya's here too. Would calling her "Snake Lady" make it easier to understand? Somewhere around... Ah, you don't want me to call you?

text.ja: ここだけの話だけれど、弟の娘たち……どちらを選ぶつもりなの？　両方は少し欲張りでしょう？　……まさか、よその女にするつもり？
text.en: Just between us, your brother's daughters… which one are you planning to pick? Wanting both is a bit greedy, isn't it? …Surely you're not thinking of going with some other woman?

text.ja: せっかくだしオイルでも塗ってもらおうかしら。何を恥ずかしがっているの、いずれは親類になる者同士、親睦を深めるのも大切でしょう
text.en: Since we have the chance, how about you let me apply some oil? What's there to be embarrassed about? We'll be relatives soon enough, so deepening our bond is important.

text.ja: マリカはお留守番……というか、こういう開放的な場所でも気を張っちゃうのよ。むしろ領地の守りを任せた方がのびのびやるでしょうね
text.en: Marika's staying home… or rather, even in a place like this she gets all tense. Honestly, leaving the domain's defense to her would let her relax and thrive.

text.ja: 弟は元気にしているかしらね。最後に見たのはカリヤのイタズラでゲンナリしている顔だったけれど……また顔を出しておこうかしら
text.en: I wonder if my younger sibling is doing well. The last I saw was a bored face from Kariya's prank… maybe I should show up again.

text.ja: ナンパ男を避けるコツを教えてあげましょうか。イイ男を侍らせておくことよ。……あら、きょとんとして、謙虚ね
text.en: Want me to teach you how to avoid pick-up guys? Keep a good man around you. …Oh, you look all puzzled—so humble.

text.ja: んっ、んんっ、あああっ！　ああ、ごめんなさいね、ちょっと今撮影中で……くううぅ、何って、ＡＶのよ……ああっ、い、色々あったの
text.en: Nn, nnn, ahh! Ah, sorry, I'm in the middle of a shoot… *gasp* What? It's an AV… Ah, so many things have happened.

text.ja: はあああぁっ、おおおぉお、人間のオスなんて軟弱者ばかりだけれど……チンポだけは別よねぇ……はああぁ、気持ちいいわぁ……
text.en: Ahhh, ohhh, human males are all so weak... but their cocks are a different story, aren't they? Ahhh, it feels so good...

text.ja: はあぁあぁ、若い男のチンポおぉぉ、たまらないわねぇ……じゅるる、れろぉ……特に女を狩る気でいる子を狩るのはなおさらね
text.en: Ahhh, a young man's cock, ohhh, it's just too much... slurp, drool... especially when they're hunting for women, it's even more thrilling to hunt them down
